vote.question: On the Joint Resolution
vote.senate_document_text: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Energy relating to "Energy Conservation Program for Appliance Standards: Certification Requirements, Labeling Requirements, and Enforcement Provisions for Certain Consumer Products and Commercial Equipment".

object.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Energy relating to "Energy Conservation Program for Appliance Standards: Certification Requirements, Labeling Requirements, and Enforcement Provisions for Certain Consumer Products and Commercial Equipment".
object.passage_action_text: Passed Senate without amendment by Yea-Nay Vote. 52 - 46. Record Vote Number: 223.

text_binding.selection_reason: latest pre-vote version (rds, 2025-03-06); no Senate amendment recorded

cra.rule_title: Energy Conservation Program for Appliance Standards: Certification Requirements, Labeling Requirements, and Enforcement Provisions for Certain Consumer Products and Commercial Equipment
cra.consequence_ref: Congressional Review Act, 5 U.S.C. 801(b): a rule disapproved by an enacted joint resolution shall not take effect (or shall not continue in effect) and may not be reissued in substantially the same form without subsequent statutory authorization.

receipt.heading_failure: If the resolution does not pass
receipt.yea_means: A Yea vote is a vote to pass the joint resolution in the Senate.
receipt.nay_means: A Nay vote is a vote against passing the joint resolution.

vote_result.statement: The Senate passed the House-passed text of the joint resolution.

next_step.actual: The Senate passed the House-passed text. Because both chambers have approved the same text, it can proceed to presentment to the President.
